name: s1_stationary_obstacle_fog100
description: Scenario 1 in fog (visibility 100 m): stationary car in the ego lane, 200 m from the start, approached at 50 km/h (modelled on the Euro NCAP car-to-stationary-car tests). The sweep varies the ego speed (driver.cruiseSpeedMps and initialSpeedMps together) and the fog visibility.
